business_purpose: Issue and validate tokens; scopes; tenant binding
authorization_boundary: Token audience = sponsor tenant; scopes least-privilege; agent-principal tokens carry delegation id and caps
data_contract_summary: OAuth2 token request/response; JWT claims (sub tenant scope act delegation_id caps)
validation: standard OAuth2 + mTLS cert binding for institutions
idempotency: N/A (token issuance not idempotent; refresh rotation)
error_handling: RFC 6749 errors at token endpoint; RFC 9457 elsewhere
privacy: no PII in tokens beyond subject id
commercialization_reason: commodity (use an IdP); value is the DAF-specific scope model not the issuer

business_purpose: Create and maintain parties and relationships
authorization_boundary: Party may read/update own profile; advisor reads clients only via privilege; staff via role
data_contract_summary: Party (kind assurance_level verified_ref) ; Relationship (type source effective period)
validation: JSON Schema; dedupe on identity attributes
versioning: URI major version /v1; additive minor changes; Sunset header
auditability: all writes evented; reads of PII logged
privacy: PII in Party vault; responses minimized per scope; field-level redaction
commercialization_reason: necessary plumbing; no standalone buyer

business_purpose: Open and administer DAF accounts under a program
authorization_boundary: Opening requires verified party + accepted agreement; tenant = sponsor
data_contract_summary: Account (program type status agreement_version)
commercialization_reason: embedded DAF accounts for wealth platforms and fintechs (Model C)

business_purpose: Grant and revoke scoped rights incl. advisors and AI agent principals (DD-017)
authorization_boundary: Only account holder (or successor) may grant; grantee must be verified; agent grants carry value caps and confirmation rules
data_contract_summary: PrivilegeGrant (grantee scope limits expiry consent_ref)
validation: scope within program policy; caps <= policy max
privacy: grant visible to grantor and grantee only
commercialization_reason: agent-delegation standard for philanthropy could be licensed; ecosystem lever

business_purpose: Declare intents; track settlement; acknowledgments
authorization_boundary: Account privilege recommend/contribute; custodian inbound feeds via mTLS service identity
data_contract_summary: ContributionIntent (asset expected_qty reference); Contribution (settlement_ref completed_date book_value valuation_method)
commercialization_reason: contribution intake and orphan matching sellable to sponsors (C2.1)

business_purpose: Complex asset acceptance case submission and status
authorization_boundary: Submitter must hold contribute privilege; decision is human (H)
data_contract_summary: AcceptanceRequest (asset descriptor documents) ; AcceptanceDecision
commercialization_reason: non-cash intake workflow sellable; competes with non-cash vendors

business_purpose: Read positions mirrored from qualified custodian
authorization_boundary: Read scoped to account privileges; no write externally
data_contract_summary: Position (pool account custody_ref qty basis as_of)
commercialization_reason: reads are table stakes

business_purpose: Donor/advisor requests to change allocation or trade within mandate
authorization_boundary: Request only (DD-003); mandate checker decides; trade instruction internal
data_contract_summary: InvestmentRequest (account action target) ; Decision
commercialization_reason: pre-trade mandate checking for advisor-managed DAFs

business_purpose: Submit grant recommendations (requests)
consumers: Donors; advisors; donor agents; embedded partners; giving platforms
authorization_boundary: Recommend privilege; agent principals within caps; request never an instruction
data_contract_summary: Recommendation (account recipient amount purpose restriction recognition channel requester)
validation: schema; amount <= available; recipient identifier form
commercialization_reason: grant recommendation API for embedded philanthropy and wealth platforms

business_purpose: Read grant state machine; cancel before release; webhooks
authorization_boundary: Account privilege or recipient identity for own grants; no external approve endpoint
data_contract_summary: Grant (state decision_refs payment_ref open-record projection)
validation: N/A for reads; cancel only pre-release
versioning: /v1; open grant record schema v0.1 projection
privacy: recipient sees donor info per anonymity only
commercialization_reason: shared grant status is the main pain for nonprofits; status network

business_purpose: Resolve recipients; return bitemporal eligibility facts and evaluation
consumers: Internal decisioning; other sponsors; giving platforms; fintechs
authorization_boundary: Read-only; tenant policy applied to evaluation; raw IRS facts public data
data_contract_summary: Recipient; EligibilityFact (type value source version effective recorded); Evaluation (result reasons as_of)
idempotency: GET idempotent; batch POST with Idempotency-Key
privacy: public data mostly; screening queries reveal donor intent so logged and not shared
commercialization_reason: continuous dated eligibility evidence; buyers sponsors processors; competitors Candid Charity Check etc.

business_purpose: Dossiers for non-routine recipients (foreign ER fiscal sponsors)
consumers: Internal grants compliance; other sponsors (shared determinations)
authorization_boundary: Read by tenant; shared determinations only with recipient consent and legal review
data_contract_summary: Dossier (sources findings evidence grade preparer agent reviewer)
privacy: recipient data; no donor data in shared dossiers
commercialization_reason: shared equivalency/ER dossiers reduce duplicated work across sponsors; legal reliance unclear

business_purpose: Evaluate a subject against a published policy version; dry-run
authorization_boundary: Publish internal only with change board approval; evaluate scoped to tenant
data_contract_summary: Policy (id version rules approval_ref); Evaluation (result rule_ids inputs_hash)
idempotency: evaluate is pure (same inputs = same output)
commercialization_reason: policy-as-code with back-testing sellable to sponsors (C5.1)

business_purpose: Internal payment instruction and settlement tracking
consumers: Payment gate only; settlement inbound from rails
exposure: internal only (inbound webhooks from rails via mTLS)
authorization_boundary: No external client may instruct payments; only C3.4 gate after GrantApproved
data_contract_summary: PaymentInstruction (grants rail amount idempotency_key); Settlement; Return
validation: gate checks (profile verified; limits; dual control)
privacy: bank tokens only; raw account numbers in vault
commercialization_reason: disbursement+reconciliation sold as service only on top of regulated rail partner (Chariot-like); money transmission constraints

business_purpose: Read balances transactions statements; no external writes
exposure: partner (read) / internal (write via posting rules only)
authorization_boundary: Ledger writes only from posting rules consuming events; reads per privilege
data_contract_summary: JournalEntry; Balance; Statement
commercialization_reason: ledger itself not differentiating; event-sourced fund accounting maybe for white-label

business_purpose: Match internal vs custodian/bank/rail; break status
authorization_boundary: Read breaks by tenant; resolution by authorized staff
data_contract_summary: ReconciliationResult (sources keys status aging)
commercialization_reason: cross-institution reconciliation is an evidenced pain (daf-cross-institution-reconciliation-evidence)

business_purpose: Fee schedules; computed charges; advisor fee caps
authorization_boundary: Read own; schedule changes internal with board approval
data_contract_summary: FeeSchedule (version tiers caps); Charge
commercialization_reason: fee transparency feature not product

business_purpose: Statements; tax documents; 990 schedule data; partner reports
consumers: Donors; advisors; partners; regulators via filings
authorization_boundary: Per privilege; regulatory outputs internal
data_contract_summary: Report (type period lineage) ; Document (type hash)
commercialization_reason: commodity except open grant record exports (portability)

business_purpose: Push state changes to authorized subscribers
authorization_boundary: Subscriber sees only events for subjects it may read; payload minimized
data_contract_summary: Webhook (event envelope + typed payload) signed (HMAC + timestamp)
privacy: payload minimized; links to authorized reads
commercialization_reason: shared grant-status network for nonprofits and platforms

business_purpose: Read decision records and control evidence
consumers: Auditors; regulators (on request); board; licensed sponsors
authorization_boundary: Read-only; auditor scopes time-boxed; tenant isolation
data_contract_summary: Decision (type actor policy_ref inputs_hash evidence links); Evidence (control subject hash time)
commercialization_reason: continuous audit evidence sellable to sponsors and auditors (C4.5)

business_purpose: Human work items; decisions within delegated authority
authorization_boundary: Decide only within delegated authority; not own or related cases
data_contract_summary: ExceptionCase (subject flags sla assignee authority_required); Resolution
commercialization_reason: unified exception orchestration as infrastructure product

business_purpose: Enterprise event stream for projections telemetry twin
authorization_boundary: Module-level subscriptions; no external raw stream
data_contract_summary: Event envelope (event-catalog.md §1)
commercialization_reason: internal backbone

business_purpose: Recipient information with evidence grades; donor goal tools
authorization_boundary: Read; no paid placement
data_contract_summary: RecipientProfile (facts evidence_grade sources)
commercialization_reason: competes with Candid/Charity Navigator; differentiation is evidence grading
